name: Pocket Brew
description: A 1-liter bottle that cold-brews coffee right inside it. Add grounds to the removable steel filter, fill with water, and it's ready after brewing overnight in the fridge. Fictional sample product used for testing.
target_audience: busy commuters and students who love iced coffee but hate paying cafe prices
selling_points: Brews smooth cold brew overnight in the fridge
Leak-proof lid you can toss in a bag
Removable stainless steel filter rinses clean in seconds
Holds 1 liter, enough for several cups
